def merge(arr, l, r):
    if l + 1 == r:
        return 0

    mid = (l + r) >> 1
    ans = merge(arr, l, mid) + merge(arr, mid, r)
    _arr = []
    i, j = l, mid
    for _ in range(l, r):
        if j == r or (i < mid and arr[i] > arr[j]):
            _arr.append(arr[i])
            i += 1
        else:
            _arr.append(arr[j])
            j += 1
            ans += mid - i
    for idx, item in enumerate(_arr):
        arr[l+idx] = item
    #print(arr)
    return ans
n = int(input())
arr = list(map(int, input().split(' ')))
ans = merge(arr, 0, n)
print(ans)
